scope: All 2016–2025 table values are cathodes, expressed as contained copper. Do not infer product mass or purity.
Sales are not confirmed shipments, deliveries, consumption, inventory drawdown or current demand.
The reporting aggregates are not named facilities. No allocation to a Codelco division or private operation is inferred.
Sales/refined-production ratio is a same-year descriptive comparison, not market share, recovery or a complete copper balance.
Refined production minus these partial sales cannot be called exports, spare supply, uncommitted inventory or unmet demand.
The corporate market-share statement and other narrative/company figures on the source page are excluded.
